svg.title: A-100 Ground Floor Plan — Detached Villa
svg.text: Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Final draft — layout agreed. The floor you receive people
on: the family living is upstairs where the balconies are,
so this one takes arrival, eating and a guest suite for
anyone who cannot manage the stair.
2. Hall, dining and kitchen are one open sequence. The spine
is cased open to both at 2.60 and 1.60 m, and the kitchen
serves the dining through a 2.50 m opening rather than a
door. Only the guest suite and the two service rooms are
3. The reception hall is the whole west strip at 43.1 m²,
with the stair standing in it. It turns the corner behind
the stair and runs on to the north wall, so the guest
bedroom opens off the hall and there is no circulation
4. Guest WC, laundry and store are one block against the west
wall, the only part of this floor that is walled off. East
and north carry ordinary windows, the west louvred
5. The front door is in the hall's south wall, under the
cantilever, which projects about 1.75 m there — so the
entrance is covered without a porch being added to the
elevation. Three risers up from the forecourt at −0.50.
6. Bedrooms are numbered 1 to 11 through the house, south to
north and west before east on each floor; the ground
floor's room is the guest bedroom and carries no number.
7. The A-300 enlargements are the last sheets still on the
Final draft — layout agreed with the client; not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P11 2026-10-07 penthouse: 2.51 m corridor outside the flat; living room to the face
P12 2026-10-07 bedrooms numbered 1-11; all five floors issued as final draft
P13 2026-10-07 site plan redrawn for the detached villa
P14 2026-10-07 section A-A recut through the east strip, and marked on every plan
